title: Night Market Lamp Posts
description:
## Task

Stalls at a night market stand along one straight lane, each at an integer position. A lamp can be placed at any position and lights every stall within `reach` of it, on either side (inclusive). Return the fewest lamps that light every stall.

## Input

- `stalls` — a list of integer positions, in any order; several stalls may share a position. It may be empty.
- `reach` — how far each lamp lights in both directions (zero means it lights only its own position).

## Output

The fewest lamps needed (an integer).

## Example

```python
lamp_count([1, 2, 9, 3, 10], 2)  # returns 2
lamp_count([5, 5, 5], 0)  # returns 1
lamp_count([0, 4, 8], 2)  # returns 2
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `stalls` ≤ 10^5
- -10^9 ≤ each position ≤ 10^9
- 0 ≤ `reach` ≤ 10^9
signature: def lamp_count(stalls: list[int], reach: int) -> int
